title: Expert Groups For Estimating Poverty
definition: The formal institutional mechanisms and expert committees constituted by the Government of India to define poverty lines, establish measurement methodologies, and estimate poverty incidence across rural and urban sectors.
importanceInUpsc: Central to Indian Economy syllabus (Human Development, Poverty, Employment). Frequently tested in Prelims through chronological ordering of committees, methodology shifts (Calorie intake vs. Multi-dimensional), and specific data points, while Mains requires evaluating inclusive growth and policy targeting.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Expert Groups For Estimating Poverty.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) surveys
Difference between absolute and relative poverty
